digest.component_or_area: tickets store git maintenance and history rewrite
propositions: Tickets store git repository pack size has grown to approximately 131.4 GiB, exceeding the 128 MiB CI verification limit and causing stale-based changes to fail pack-size gates

History rewrite via git fast-export/filter/fast-import combined with repack and gc must reclaim spent ~1 GiB and reduce the filtered pack below the 131,072 KiB limit while preserving commit/merge counts, tree identity, and event multiset equivalence
Pre-rewrite and post-rewrite identity verification must confirm identical pre/post summaries and byte-identical (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multisets after ignoring rewritten commit SHAs

Bug 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a diagnostic repairs must be executed and verified before history rewrite, with rebar fsck confirming zero repairable diagnostics and exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records

Publication must use exact force-with-lease on the rewritten tip, verified off-repo bundles must exist before and after repair, and old tip must not be an ancestor in any default-cloned ref after publication

Deterministic first post-rewrite write with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN disabled must be the sole canonical review-bot vote sequence (CREATE, REVIEW_RESULT, two link commits; no interleave) and increase pack size by less than 1 MiB
